oneOf.description: Deletions go to the person's Trash, or do not happen.
The companion has no Trash: nothing is deleted from the browser (`trash-unavailable`).

EnvState.description:
The environment captured from the person's login shell for git hooks (`devtab init`, `devtab env capture`):
when, and the folders of its `PATH`. `capturedAt` is null until it is captured.

FileMode.description: What the page may do with an open file.

OpenFilesState.description: `companion.state.openFiles`: the setting for open files that run by themselves.

executes.description: `edit`: written with a mark (the default); `read`: read-only (`devtab files policy --executes`).

oneOf.description: The server binary does not match its pin or broke an invariant; it is not run.

deletePolicy.description:
How deletions from the browser happen: `trash` when they go to the Trash, `unavailable` while the companion
has no Trash (`file.delete` is then not in `welcome.methods`, and every deletion is refused with
`trash-unavailable`, nothing deleted).

openFiles.description:
The setting for open files (`openFile.*`). Companions older than open files do not send it (nor list the
`openFile.*` methods in `welcome.methods`).

paused.description: Whether writing is paused (always false: this version has no pause).

problems.description: Problems the person should know about, as short English sentences; `devtab doctor` explains each.

summary: The companion's state: versions, server state, problems.
